snippet.title: Non-violent Hero 非暴力系勇者 // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3808010/Nonviolent_Hero/

A pixel RPG where you play as a handsome, non-violent Hero on a mission to help the King rescue his daughter, who has been kidnapped by the Demon King!

Developed by
Wito aka @Witooao.0
